author: pocheang
body:
Stacked on #61. Fixes the three limitations the acceptance report left open.

## 1. Routing: a security object in an image

"图片里的木马样本哈希是什么？" went to the document reader. The keyword rules suggested security, but the model overrode them and read the question as OCR. The guide now says the object asked about decides, not the file type, and addresses the "what is X in this image" shape using a different example from the eval question.

Measured with the router's decision cache cleared between calls (it memoizes by question, so repeated calls in one process are a single sample):
- edge-11 goes to security 10/10.
- "OCR this photo" and "read the text in this screenshot" still go to the document reader, 4/4 each.
- Full routing eval: **class right on 68/68** (67 before).

## 2. Chinese documents get sections

Numbered Chinese titles are now headings: 第X章, 第X节, 第X条, 一、, （一）. A line counts only if it is short, contains no clause punctuation, and doesn't end with a colon. A bare title is still not treated as a heading, because it can't be told apart from a short sentence.

- Law texts: 264/264 numbered heading lines found, nothing else flagged.
- Developer corpus: 0 of 167 Chinese lines flagged.
- A real ingest of a Chinese contract labels its chunks 第一章 总则 / 二、巡检 / 第四章 保密.

## 3. Cross-language tool grounding

Chinese AI-estimate answers citing their English tool summary had their sections hedged. There were two causes:
- **Merged label lines.** Bold labels and list-intro lines merged with the lines below them. They are now spans of their own.
- **Cross-language overlap.** A sentence citing `[T{k}]` that fails on word overlap is now judged against that tool's output. Every number must appear there (list ordinals aside). A sentence with no numbers, written in a different script from its tool, is taken as attributed. A figure the tool never produced is still hedged.

A4, four runs: 0, 0, 1 and 3 hedges, where every section used to be hedged. The ones left are uncited advice and figures the tool didn't produce.

## Tests

- Heading detection: 17 new cases, positive and negative.
- Chinese chapter carried onto its chunks.
- `test_grounding_across_languages.py` (11).
- Removing the tool check fails the measured-answer test; removing the label split fails the span test.

author: kohz87
body:
## Summary
Delta decides who is present only by scanning AI replies. If an NPC was absent in message 4 and the player's message 5 called her back in, reply 6 was written without her dossier and could contradict it on appearance, voice or levers.

- `updateInjection` now finds the pending player turn: the chat tail when it is a user message, or the user turn before an assistant reply that hasn't been scanned yet (swipe or regenerate).
- It checks that turn for off-screen dossiers by name, alias or a distinctive first name, using the new `npcNamedInText` helper. Archived and confirmed-dead NPCs are never included.
- Matched NPCs are passed to `buildInjection` as `namedNpcIds`. Each joins selection, is marked `(named by player)`, and adds one header line saying they are not yet confirmed on-screen.
- Presence itself is not changed; the scan of the reply still decides it.
- The injection refreshes on `MESSAGE_SENT` and on non-dry, non-quiet `GENERATION_AFTER_COMMANDS` (regenerate, swipe, continue).
- The Diagnostics **Roleplay injection** section lists the NPCs that were named by the player and actually injected.
- The version is bumped to 1.0.72 in every version marker; changelog, README and DEVELOPMENT notes are updated.

Scanner prompts, request counts, routing, scoring and persisted formats are unchanged. When no off-screen NPC is named, the injection is byte-identical to before.

## Verification
- `npm test`: 865/865 pass.
  - New `tests/v1072-named-by-player-injection.test.js` covers:
    - a named off-screen NPC is injected with her anatomy and is not made present
    - output is unchanged for present or unnamed NPCs
    - archived NPCs are excluded
    - names, aliases and first names are matched, and unrelated text is not
  - The synthetic-host smoke test covers both directions:
    - a pending message naming an off-screen NPC injects her, marked, without making her present
    - an unrelated pending message sends nothing
- `npm run validate`: passes.
- `node scripts/measure-stage9.mjs`: matches the committed baseline.
- `npm run package`: builds `npc_state_delta-1.0.72.zip`.
- `git diff --check`: clean.
- Not verified: the timing of `GENERATION_AFTER_COMMANDS` in a live SillyTavern. It is covered only by the event guard; there is no live-host check.

author: pbelaustegui
body:
## Problem

`extract` refused real BBVA card statements with `ambiguous-importer`: both `ProvinciaVisa` and `BBVACard` claimed the file. `ProvinciaVisa.identify` matched any text containing `Liquidacion`, and a BBVA Visa/Mastercard liquidación carries that word too.

## Fix

- `ProvinciaVisa.identify` now yields whenever BBVA's structural check (`is_bbva_card_liquidacion`: `CIERRE ACTUAL` + `SALDO ANTERIOR` + a `FECHA`/`PESOS` header) claims the file. Banco Provincia's liquidación never carries `CIERRE ACTUAL`.
- New registry-level test: each BBVA card fixture (Visa, Mastercard) is claimed by exactly one importer in `get_importers()`. It failed before the fix with `['ProvinciaVisa', 'BBVACard']`.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest -q`: 961 passed, 7 skipped.
- `uv run ruff check .`: clean.
- Real file: `extract --source BBVACard` on a real BBVA card statement no longer refuses as `ambiguous-importer` (run by the owner, outside the agent's context).
- Native risk assessment: medium, `under_budget`; no review due for this slice yet.

body:
Fixes #1300

## What

The desktop frontend's Node.js floor is now `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0` everywhere it is stated or pinned:

| where | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs/develop/desktop-gui.md` | "Node.js 20.19 or newer" | `^22.22.2 \|\| ^24.15.0 \|\| >=26.0.0`, with where it comes from |
| `devbox.json` | `nodejs@24.12.0` (below `^24.15.0`) | `github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-26.05#nodejs_24`, locked at **24.21.0** |
| `desktop/package.json` | no `engines` | `"engines": { "node": "^22.22.2 \|\| ^24.15.0 \|\| >=26.0.0" }` |

**Why that range:** it is `jsdom`'s `engines.node` and the narrowest of the lockfile's 34 distinct `engines.node` ranges. Checked with `semver` against 20.19.0, 22.12.0, 22.22.1, 22.22.2, 22.23.2, 24.12.0, 24.14.1, 24.15.0, 24.21.0, 25.9.0, 26.0.0 and 26.8.1, it accepts and rejects exactly what the whole lockfile does.

## Why a flake reference and not `nodejs@24.x`

Devbox's versioned index has no Node 24.x above 24.12.0. `search.devbox.sh/v2/resolve?name=nodejs&version=24` answers 24.12.0 and `…&version=24.15.0` returns `404 no package found` (checked 2026-09-28). nixpkgs does carry newer builds: `nixos-26.05`'s `nodejs_24` is 24.21.0. The index does offer `nodejs@22.23.2` and `nodejs@26.8.1`, and both satisfy the range. I rejected both because either would take a `devbox shell` off the Node 24 line that CI (`desktop-web`, `desktop-browser`, `desktop-driver`) and `release.yml`'s `desktop-bundle` run with `node-version: 24`. `docs/develop/devbox-concurrency.md` names that alignment as the reason Node is pinned in Devbox at all.

**What that costs**, written into the doc:
- `devbox.json` now names only the major and the branch. The exact version lives in `devbox.lock` as the resolved nixpkgs revision.
- Renovate's devbox manager has no version to bump on this entry, and lock-file maintenance is already disabled for `devbox.lock`. The entry moves only on `devbox update`, which picks up patch releases on the 24 line, or by hand when Node 24 leaves maintenance.

I measured `disable_plugin: true` (issue #791) on this entry with devbox 0.18.0. Devbox attaches no Node plugin to a flake-reference entry, with or without the flag, and no `.devbox/virtenv/nodejs` appears either way. It is kept so the #791 fix survives if the entry ever goes back to a versioned `nodejs@…` form. The doc says it is inert today.

## What the `engines` field does and does not do

It is a **declaration, not a gate**. pnpm 11.22.0 installed this lockfile with `--frozen-lockfile` under Node 24.12.0 without a warning, `--config.engine-strict=true` included. The doc says so rather than implying enforcement. The bottom of the range stays untested: CI and Devbox are both on the newest 24.x.

## Not changed

- `scripts/check-pin-lockstep.sh` does not cover Node. CI pins only the bare major `node-version: 24`, so there is no second exact pin to compare. The guard still passes: Rust, cargo-nextest and pnpm are `ok`.
- `desktop/pnpm-lock.yaml` is untouched. Adding a root `engines` field does not change the lockfile, and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passes. Nothing here should conflict with Renovate #1377 / #1371.
- **No changelog fragment** (rule 19): developer tooling, and a user of the released CLI/desktop cannot observe it.
- Not a daemon/protocol/hook change, so rule 12 does not apply.

## Checks run locally

- `cargo fmt --check`: clean
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features e2e,e2e-live -- -D warnings`: clean
- `cargo test-fast`: 4716 passed, 1 skipped, including `pin_lockstep.rs`
- `scripts/check-pin-lockstep.sh`: ok ×3
- `devbox install`, then `.devbox/nix/profile/default/bin/node --version` → `v24.21.0`, with pnpm 11.22.0
- In `desktop/` under that Node: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm test` (38 files / 1036 tests), `pnpm build` (`tsc && vite build`), `pnpm test:browser:types`, `pnpm test:driver:types`

One `pnpm test` run, made while `cargo clippy` was compiling alongside it, reported one failed test (1035/1036). The test's name was cut off by my output truncation. Six reruns, two of them under the same concurrent cargo load, all passed 1036/1036. It is unidentified, and I have no evidence it relates to the Node version.

author: simplifaisoul
body:
## What changes

**The load always flies in now.** When a visitor can't be located, for example when the site is reached over a private network or VPN with no public address, `/api/geo` answers "unknown" in production. The camera then stayed on the globe and the fly-in never happened.

If the location lookup **answers unknown, fails, or hasn't answered within 6 s**, the camera now lands on a **random city** instead. The 20 candidates all have dense live-camera coverage, so every landing shows the platform at work:

- **Europe:** London, Paris, Amsterdam, Berlin, Madrid, Rome, Istanbul
- **Asia-Pacific:** Tokyo, Seoul, Taipei, Hong Kong, Bangkok, Sydney, Auckland
- **Americas:** Los Angeles, Seattle, Houston, Miami, Las Vegas, Montreal

- **Never the same city twice in a row.** The last pick is remembered in the browser (`localStorage`, fail-safe when storage is blocked).
- **No second jump.** A real location that arrives after the random pick is ignored.
- **Visitors whose city is known are unchanged:** they still land on their own city.

The list and picker live in `src/lib/landing-cities.ts`. The fallback is wired into the existing location request in `page.tsx`.

## Checked
- A V5.0 deployment reached over a private network stayed on the globe: `/api/geo` answered `{"status":"fail","message":"Visitor address unknown"}`.
- Simulated that exact answer on localhost in headless Chrome. Visit 1 flew into **Sydney**, visit 2 into **Hong Kong**.
- A normal load still lands on the visitor's own city.
- `vitest`: **964 passed**, including 4 new tests for the city list and picker (valid coordinates, full range, no repeat, never out of range). `tsc` is clean, and `page.tsx` lints exactly as on master.

author: shinichirogoto
body:
Implements **docs/SPEC-M2.2.md**: kioku runs natively on Windows as a **client** (hooks + the `kioku mcp` bridge). The server stays on macOS/Linux. Implementation notes and spec corrections are in SPEC-M2.2 §12.

## What is in this PR

**kioku.exe (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)**
- `release.yml` builds `kioku-<tag>-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.gz` (kioku.exe + READMEs + licenses) with `.sha256`, and it is listed in `SHA256SUMS`. `.sha256` lines are `<hex>  <file>` on every OS.
- Tags that contain `-` (`v1.2.3-rc1`, `v0.0.0-test1`) are now published as GitHub **pre-releases**, so a dry-run tag can never become `releases/latest`.
- There is no Windows code signing (SmartScreen note in the README).

**Platform rules (§4)**
- `util::plain_path` / `canonical_plain` strip `\\?\` and `\\?\UNC\`. They are used by `project::identify`, the registered binary path, and `update`.
- `util::quiet_command` sets `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` for git (kioku-core) and for tar and the version probe (update).
- Hook stdin is read as bytes: the BOM is stripped and the rest decoded as lossy UTF-8. stdout/stderr are written as UTF-8 bytes. A test covers a BOM + CRLF + Japanese payload.
- The doctor looks up PATH with `split_paths` and finds `kioku.exe`. `command_binary` keeps Windows backslashes and skips a leading `&`.
- The service reports `Unsupported("Windows: kioku runs as a client only")`. `setup` without `--client-only` on Windows fails early with the spec's message.
- A unix `/…` cwd in a payload counts as absolute on Windows too. Relative `apply_patch` paths are joined with the payload OS's separator.

**Hooks / MCP (§7)** use `HookPlatform::{Unix, Windows}`. It is a parameter, so every Windows shape is unit-tested on every OS.
- Claude Code: exec form `{"type":"command","command":"C:\\…\\kioku.exe","args":["hook","stop"]}`. install, uninstall and doctor recognise it next to the string form.
- Codex: `command` = `"C:\…\kioku.exe" hook <e> --agent codex`, and `commandWindows` = `& "C:\…\kioku.exe" hook <e> --agent codex`. `config.toml` gets `command = 'C:\…\kioku.exe'`, a TOML literal string.
- Cursor (best effort): the quoted string form.
- Gemini CLI and Antigravity are not auto-detected on Windows.

**`kioku update` (§5)**
- The new binary is extracted and verified, then `kioku.exe` → `kioku.exe.old` and `kioku.exe.new` → `kioku.exe`. The old binary is restored if the second rename fails.
- A leftover `.old` is deleted at the top of `main`, which also covers `--version`.
- Uses the system `tar.exe`.

**install.ps1 (§6)** works with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 and needs no admin rights.
- Behaviour: arch check, latest/`-Version`, `KIOKU_DOWNLOAD_BASE`/`KIOKU_REPO`, `Get-FileHash` against `SHA256SUMS` (falling back to `<asset>.sha256`), install to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\kioku`, the rename dance, a PATH hint (it only edits PATH with `-AddToPath`), and `-ClientOnly <url> <token>` / `-NoSetup` / pass-through args.
- Errors are thrown, not `exit`, so the user's window never closes.
- `install.sh` under Git Bash now points to install.ps1.

**`--print-client-command` (§8)** prints the install.ps1 line after the install.sh line (same URL and token).

**CI**
- `windows-latest` is added to the fmt/clippy/test matrix. Steps now run even after an earlier step failed, so one run shows every problem.
- New `install.ps1 (windows-latest)` job: `scripts/test-install.ps1` runs under pwsh and under Windows PowerShell 5.1 against a local fixture server. Stub `kioku.exe`s are compiled with csc.
- The pwsh pass also installs the **real** kioku.exe. It checks that `setup` without `--client-only` is refused, that a BOM + Japanese hook payload is read, and that `kioku update` replaces the running exe (`.old` removed by the next run).
- Unix-only tests (launchd/systemd golden files, the shell-script update fixture) are `#[cfg(unix)]`.

**Docs:** a Windows section in README and README.ja: install.ps1, client-only, SmartScreen, ACLs, WSL/Orca.

## Verified from official docs / source (2026-09-28)
- **Claude Code exec form:** the fields are `command` + `args`, with no shell. On Windows `command` must be a real `.exe` (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, "Exec form and shell form").
- **Claude desktop Code tab:** it reads the same `~/.claude/settings.json` hooks and `~/.claude.json` MCP servers as the CLI (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop, "Shared configuration").
- **Codex `commandWindows`:** it is honoured in hooks.json (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). The source is openai/codex `main`:
  - `codex-rs/config/src/hook_config.rs` has `rename = "commandWindows", alias = "command_windows"`.
  - `hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs` makes commandWindows replace command on Windows.
  - The command runs through the session shell, `pwsh`/`powershell -NoProfile -Command`.

## Spec points that turned out wrong (fixed in SPEC-M2.2 §7.2 / §12)
- On Windows, Codex's `commandWindows` **replaces** `command` even in the `%COMSPEC% /C` fallback, so `command` is not the cmd.exe path. Both fields are still written.
- install.ps1 cannot pass "everything after `--`": PowerShell consumes `--`. Unknown args still pass through.
- The update/installer version probe runs the extracted `kioku.exe`, not `kioku.exe.new`, because PowerShell would open a non-`.exe` through a file association.

## Still UNVERIFIED: needs the maintainer's Windows machine (SPEC-M2.2 §10)
- The Claude Code version that introduced `args`. An old build that ignores `args` would run the bare path through a shell, clap would exit 2, and exit 2 is a *blocking* hook error. Check `claude --version`.
- Whether the **released** Codex desktop app runs `commandWindows` through PowerShell as `main` does. Also whether `& "…"` works under the rare cmd.exe fallback.
- How Cursor runs hook commands on Windows.
- A `\\wsl.localhost\…` repository producing the remote-based project id. Orca's WSL-isolated Codex home.
- The captures under `tests/fixtures/windows/{claude-code,codex}/` (§10 step 4) and the cross-machine handoff (§10 step 5).

## Release dry-run
The throwaway tag `v0.0.0-test1` on this branch ran release.yml, and all 8 jobs passed, including `build x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`. The run published a **pre-release**, so `releases/latest` stayed v0.4.2. The Windows tarball held `kioku.exe` + READMEs + licenses, and its checksum was listed in `SHA256SUMS`. The tag and the release were then deleted.

## CI (last run)
All jobs passed: fmt/clippy/test on ubuntu, macos and windows; install.sh on ubuntu and macos; install.ps1 on windows. The install.ps1 job passed 24/24 checks under pwsh 7.6 and 19/19 under Windows PowerShell 5.1.

## Not done / for the maintainer
- No new crates.
- Windows code signing: not done.
- Release tags: none real.

body:
Summary: Add CI

| Job | Command | What it checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| user-service | docker compose --profile test run --build --rm user-tests | gofmt -l (fails on unformatted code), go vet, go test -race ./... against a disposable PostgreSQL database, then go build |
| supplier-service | same with supplier-tests | as above, for Supplier |
| credit-service | same with credit-tests | as above, for Credit — including the ledger tests that exercise transaction and lock ordering |
| frontend | docker compose --profile test run --build --rm frontend-checks | ESLint, tsc --noEmit, and a production next build |
| smoke | sh scripts/smoke.sh | live end-to-end run of the whole stack |

### What the smoke job covers
 
It starts the real stack behind the gateway and drives it over HTTP with the session cookie a browser would hold, in two phases against one throwaway account:
 
- **setup** — register, pull the verification code out of the Mailpit inbox, verify the email, log in, browse the seeded supplier list, confirm a non-admin is refused (`403`) on supplier create, update and delete, then log out and confirm the revoked cookie is refused (`401`).
- **check** — after `promote-admin` makes the same account an admin, log back in and exercise supplier CRUD: create, read, rename, duplicate-name rejection (`409`), combined search/filter/sort/pagination, deactivate and read back, soft-delete (`204`), and confirm that a request without an `Origin` header and a cross-origin request are both rejected.

body:
## Summary
- Wires the real `/book` screen (`BranchBooking.tsx`) for non-contiguous multi-slot selection: toggle any number of slots on/off, real per-slot server-resolved pricing, inline held/rejected result after submit.
- Single-slot path is byte-identical to today (`POST /bookings`, navigates to `/bookings/:id/pay`) — verified live, matches what existing e2e specs assert.
- 2+ slots use the new `POST /booking-orders` (F-310 Phase 1), with the real `{ held, rejected }` split rendered inline before an explicit "Continue to My Bookings" tap.
- PaymentIntent-linking (deferred in Phase 1) is sidestepped, not built: each slot in an order is paid individually through the existing, unmodified `BookingPay.tsx` via `BookingHistory.tsx`'s existing per-booking "Pay Now" link.
- `BookingHistory.tsx` groups bookings sharing an `orderId` under a shared "Order of N" heading — additive only, existing card content unchanged.

## Real bugs caught and fixed during this work
- **Backend integration bug**: `POST /booking-orders` replied `409` with a real body on a fully-rejected order, but `apiRequest()` discards non-2xx bodies without an `error` key — the guest UI would have silently lost the held/rejected split. Fixed to always reply `201`. The underlying shared-client defect is filed separately as **F-312** (not fixed here — its own real scope).
- **Self-caught process error**: the first implementation pass targeted `CourtBooking.tsx` (the file the original handover named), which real browser verification revealed is dead code — not routed anywhere in `main.tsx`. Reverted cleanly and re-implemented against `BranchBooking.tsx`, the actual live component.
- **F-311** filed: `POST /bookings` has the same missing tenant-isolation gap this phase's Codacy review caught and fixed on the new route — pre-existing, not introduced here.

## Test plan
- [x] Real browser session (real OTP-based guest auth, no mocks): multi-select toggle, capacity display (0 while selected, reverts on deselect via grid + panel ×), full-success submit (2 of 2 held, ₹200 total), real partial-failure race (1 of 2 held, accurate rejection message)
- [x] "Continue to My Bookings" → `/bookings/my` shows "ORDER OF 2" grouping
- [x] One slot paid through unmodified `BookingPay.tsx` → real `CONFIRMED` (DB read-back); sibling stayed `HELD` (DB read-back)
- [x] Cancelled the still-`HELD` sibling → real `CANCELLED` (DB read-back); `CONFIRMED` one unaffected
- [x] Single-slot path independently re-verified live: still calls unmodified `POST /bookings`, navigates to `/bookings/:id/pay`
- [x] Whole-app typecheck and `tsc && vite build` clean
- [ ] Playwright specs (`guest-booking.spec.ts` etc.) not re-run this round — needs the full Caddy-fronted `docker-compose.dev.yml` stack, not stood up this session; single-slot behavior confirmed live instead, same real code path

## 무엇을 바꿨나요?

README의 문장을 실제 코드(`index.html`, `js/app.js`)와 하나씩 대조했어요. 빠졌거나 부정확한 부분만 고쳤어요.

**할 수 있는 것**
- **목표**: 처음 기본값(1450 kcal / 단백질 105 g / 탄수화물 40 g / 지방 95 g)을 적었어요. 탄수화물이 "상한"이라는 점도 넣었어요.
- **기록 수정·삭제**: 기록을 누르면 이름·양·영양값·추가 항목을 고칠 수 있어요. "삭제"는 기록 옆 버튼이고, 누르면 확인 없이 바로 지워져요.
- **즐겨찾기**
  - 목록은 음식 추가 창 아래에 있어요. 기록을 수정할 때도 저장할 수 있어요.

  - 목록에서 즐겨찾기를 지울 수 있어요.

author: djisvalle
body:
Before: text and notation marks snapped only to lyric lines on the chord chart. A selection box or a dragged selection stopped at the edge of the screen, so marks on two PDF pages couldn't be selected or moved in one go. A duplicated mark on a score stopped following its notes.

After: the switch is now Snap to Lines. On a score, marks snap just above or below each staff. On a PDF page or a photo, they snap to the staves and lines of text found on the page. With the Select tool, holding a selection box or a dragged selection near the top or bottom of the visible chart scrolls it, and the scroll gets faster closer to the edge. A box can reach from page 1 onto page 2, and marks can be moved across. On a score, Duplicate's copies re-attach to their notes the way a drag already does.

How: `MxlScoreHandle.staffLines()` reads each staff's top and bottom line from the engraving (`staffBands`, `utils/scoreAnchors.ts`). For PDFs and photos, `utils/lineScan.ts` scans each page's pixels once, on the first snap of a gesture, at up to 600px wide. It looks for five evenly spaced rows of long dark lines, which make a staff, and for bands of ink between blank rows, which make lines of text. Results are cached per page element. The edge zone begins where Annotate's header and tool bar stop covering the chart. The chord chart's snapping is unchanged.

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-annotate-follow-ups-design.md`, sections 4 to 6.

Checked: `npm run build` is clean. In the browser, a dynamic dragged near a staff on the seeded score snapped onto the staff line with the guide showing. The line scan found the title, both staves and both lyric lines on a synthetic page, from a canvas and from an image. A selection box held near the bottom on the phone layout scrolled the score and kept growing. I haven't tried a real scanned PDF or a phone photo yet.

body:
## Summary
- **Workstream A:** `ChatResponseDto.TriggeredCategories` was computed per exchange and thrown away. It is now attached to the assistant `GroupChatMessage` and kept on the session as a map of category to the time it was *first* triggered. It survives Refresh Chat like the token/message totals do.
- **Workstream B:** the scoreboard awards a flat 100 points per distinct triggered category and shows a points column plus LLM01/LLM02/LLM07 badges per group.
- **Ranking:** points descending, then whoever reached their current score first, then group name. This deviates from the plan's "elapsed ascending" tiebreak on purpose: elapsed is wall-clock time since the session was created, so it would favour groups that joined later.
- **What counts as a trigger:** a search only scores if it returned rows, the ticket only scores if the injected ticket was actually read (unknown ids don't), and the codeword only if it appears in the reply. Reading the injected ticket on its own still scores `PromptInjection`; requiring the model to then obey it would be a stricter follow-up.
- Data-model and architecture docs updated to match.

author: yab007-glitch
body:
## Summary

The primary profile appeared **twice** in the `@`-mention completion: once as its raw profile id (`@default`) and once as the primary alias (`@hermes`). Two rows, one bot — the user sees a duplicate and "default" (an internal profile id, not an identity) surfaces in the UI, which the desktop Bot Mode surface deliberately never shows (see `botHandle()` in `apps/desktop/src/plugins/hermes-bots/data.ts`: the primary profile's tag is exactly `@hermes`, and `mentionNameForms` drops `default` as a reserved token).

## Root cause

`_profile_mention_items()` (`tui_gateway/methods_complete.py`) offers `@hermes` as an alias "when no real profile claims that name" — but it also offers every profile's raw name, including the primary profile `default`. With any named profile present, `@hermes` and `@default` are both offered for the same agent.

## Reproduction

1. Install with the default profile plus any named profile (e.g. a Bot Mode fleet).
2. Open any chat composer, type `@`.
3. Picker shows both `@default` and `@hermes`; typing `de` or `her` confirms both resolve to the same primary profile.

Verified live via direct invocation of `_profile_mention_items('')` before the fix (12-profile fleet):

```
['@brain', '@cato', ..., '@hermes', '@default']   # both rows present
```

## Fix

Skip the profile whose name is exactly `default` in the enumeration — the `@hermes` alias row below it is the one and only row for the primary profile. This matches the desktop-side contract where `default` never surfaces as a tag.

## Test plan

- Updated `test_lazy_skill_count_never_walks_in_the_polled_request` assertions: `@hermes` must be offered on prefix `her`, and `@default` must not appear at all (was previously asserting the `@default` row exists).
- Direct invocation check on the live install (12-profile fleet): empty prefix returns 12 rows, none named `@default`; `her` returns exactly `['@hermes']`.
- Full `tests/hermes_cli/test_profiles.py` green in CI (one pre-existing local failure is a machine-layout artifact: this checkout's parent is the real `$HOME/.hermes`, tripping the home-IO guard; fails identically on clean HEAD).

body:
## What changed

The compiler numbered the source it was given, and a bare body starts on line 17
under the usings and the wrapper class, first line indented 8, so an error on
the snippet's line 3 came back as line 19 and the agent spent a round trip
finding the line it wrote. Lines, and the first line's column, are mapped back
to the snippet; a line inside the generated wrapper reads 0.

COMPILATION_FAILED drops its fixed hint, and compiler_attempts unless a compiler
failed over to another; alone, both only repeated "compiler" on every error.
History keeps no code over 32 KB - SessionState rewrites the whole history on

author: penguinztech
body:
## Summary

`release/python-security/v0.1.x` was branched from an old shared-ancestor commit (`c07f054`) and never received the CI fixes already merged into sibling release lines via PR #105 (`release/rust-connectors/v0.1.x`) and PR #106 (`release/python-crypto/v0.1.x`). This PR ports the same fix set, plus a separately-diagnosed `publish.yml` bug.

- **`ci.yml`**: every per-package job's `if:` path-filter compared against `github.ref`, which is always `refs/pull/<n>/merge` on `pull_request` events — so every job ran unconditionally (or was skipped) regardless of which release branch a PR targeted. Switched to `(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref || github.ref_name)`.
- **`ci.yml` / `h3-packages.yml` / `prpc-packages.yml`**: removed the now-invalid `cache: false` param (and paired zizmor suppression comment) from `actions/setup-node` steps — GitHub Actions rejects `cache: false` as unsupported; bumped `golangci-lint-action` to v9.3.0 with `golangci-lint` pinned to v2.14.0; bumped `govulncheck`/`gosec` pins; added `gosec -exclude-generated`; bumped `bufbuild/buf-setup-action` to v1.50.0.
- **`publish.yml`** (separate, already-diagnosed bug, same pattern as PR #59/#66 on `release/python-dal`/`release/python-limiter`): `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` was pinned to v1.8.12, which bundles a `twine` that only parses `Metadata-Version` up to 2.2 while current `setuptools` emits 2.4 — every Python publish job failed with `InvalidDistribution: Metadata is missing required fields` before ever authenticating to PyPI. Bumped to v1.14.2 (`dc37677b2e1c63e2034f94d8a5b11f265b73ba33`). Also removed the same invalid `setup-node` `cache: false` param from `publish.yml`'s 8 Node steps (setup-go's `cache: false`, 4 occurrences, is untouched — different action, not affected by this bug).

This unblocks CI for PR #119 and #120, which are currently blocked against this branch.

- [x] Confirmed no remaining bare `github.ref` conditions in `ci.yml`
- [x] Confirmed no remaining old `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` pin in `publish.yml`
- [x] Confirmed `setup-go`'s `cache: false` left untouched (different action)

author: hilather
body:
The live acceptance check for the F1 dependent vertical slice passed on the second of three authorized attempts. Evidence is in `docs/reviews/2026-09-27-f1-live-gate.md`.

## What was shown live
Stock Herdr 0.9.1, no patch; Codex CLI 0.154.0; isolated roots and Herdr servers.
1. **Worker A:** the ticker launched a real Codex worker, which received its brief once and committed a small edit.
2. **Verify and integrate:** A's result was submitted, then automatically verified (3 policy runs) and integrated.
3. **Fault, ticker crash:** `kill -9` during A's integration candidate check. After restart: exactly one integration and one publication.
4. **Fault, stale target:** a fixture-verified result was blocked with "target moved" and the moved ref was not overwritten. The operator recovery (`hp result <slug> integrate`) then published on the moved tip.
5. **Worker B:** the dependent stayed blocked until A integrated, then was drafted, signed and reserved. A second real Codex worker started on a worktree whose HEAD was A's integrated SHA.

The first attempt was blocked by a missing capability before any live session ran. It was fixed in #51 (stock-Herdr launch) and #52 (dependent launch).

## Production changes (small; live runs failed without them)
- **Enter key:** stock Herdr runs typed text only on an explicit Enter key, so the launch line is sent with `keys:["Enter"]`. The fake Herdr now matches.
- **Preparation budget:** profile preparation and revalidation get 60s instead of 20s. Hashing the ~260 MB Codex binary several times didn't fit in 20s.
- **Codex version probe:** it now runs with the worker's execution HOME. Before, it fell back to the account's `~/.codex` and created helper links there.

## New
`scripts/test-live-f1` requires an explicit `--allow-authenticated-workflow` and applies the same auth-file checks as the existing live script. New ignored test `live_f1_worker_result_integrates_and_dependent_launches_on_integrated_sha`.

## Follow-ups recorded in the plan doc
- Two workers on one Herdr server hit a native-name mismatch loop.
- Codex's `workspace-write` sandbox makes git metadata read-only, so workers can't commit under it.
- There is no clean "finished" transition for a worker: cancelling blocks its dependents.
- The integration recheck only re-runs the first accepted policy.

## Tests
After rebasing on main: `--test cli` 65 passed (the new live test is ignored), canonical_worker/profile_preparation lib tests 110/110.

body:
## 관련 이슈

LAN-576

## 무엇을, 왜

> [!NOTE]
> **원래 무슨 문제였나요?**
>
> 배포하는 코드는 크기를 줄이려고 한 줄로 꾹 눌러 담습니다. 사람이 읽을 수 없어서, 원래 코드로 되돌려 읽는 지도(소스맵)를 Sentry에만 올려두고 배포본에서는 지웁니다.
>
> 지도를 지우면 코드 끝에 붙은 "지도는 저기 있어요" 쪽지(`sourceMappingURL` 주석)도 같이 뗍니다. 그런데 Sentry의 가위는 "쪽지 문구가 보이면 거기부터 끝까지 자른다"고만 알고 있었습니다.
>
> 리플레이 라이브러리(rrweb)는 자기 코드 일부를 글자(문자열)로 들고 다니는데, 그 글자 안에도 똑같은 쪽지 문구가 있었습니다. 압축된 코드는 전체가 한 줄이라 가위 눈에는 진짜와 가짜가 구분되지 않았습니다.
>
> ```js
> // 압축된 청크 — 코드 본문은 한 줄, 진짜 쪽지만 마지막 줄에 따로 붙는다
> var w="워커 코드…//# sourceMappingURL=w.map"; 나머지 코드 전부…
> //# sourceMappingURL=chunk.js.map
> //   ↑ 원래 떼려던 진짜 쪽지
> //   가위는 문자열 안의 가짜 쪽지부터 파일 끝까지 잘라냈다
> ```
>
> 잘린 청크는 문자열 중간에서 끝나서 브라우저가 실행하지 못했습니다. 그 결과가 한꺼번에 나타났습니다.
>
> - 배포본 콘솔에 `SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token`이 388건 쌓였습니다.
> - 그 청크에 들어 있던 Amplitude 세션 리플레이가 동작하지 않았습니다.
> - 에러가 날 때마다 Sentry 리플레이가 함께 올라가서(`replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0`) 쿼터 초과(429)까지 났습니다.

> [!TIP]
> **어떻게 고쳤나요?**
>
> 진짜 쪽지는 항상 새 줄에서 시작하고, 문자열 안의 가짜 쪽지는 줄 중간에 있습니다. 그래서 "파일 맨 앞이거나 줄바꿈 바로 뒤에 있는 쪽지만 뗀다"는 조건(`(?:^|\n)`)을 붙였습니다. 주소 부분에는 공백·따옴표·`*`가 올 수 없게 해서, 쪽지 문구가 글자 안에 있으면 끝까지 이어 붙지 못하게 했습니다.
>
> ```diff
> - /\n?\/\/[#@] sourceMappingURL=[^\n]+$/
> + /(?:^|\n)\/\/[#@] sourceMappingURL=[^\s'"`*]+\s*$/
> ```
>
> - 무작위 입력 약 90만 개와 Next.js 15·16 실제 빌드 청크 37개(Turbopack·webpack)에서 청크가 잘리지 않고 진짜 쪽지만 떼어지는 것을 확인한 뒤 Sentry에 보냈습니다.
> - 그동안은 같은 조건을 pnpm patch로 붙여 두었습니다. 수정이 11.0.0에 들어가서 이번에 버전을 올리며 패치를 지웁니다.
> - 이번 PR에서도 프로덕션 빌드 청크 68개를 전부 `node --check`로 돌려, rrweb 청크까지 끝까지 온전한 것을 확인했습니다.

- `@sentry/nextjs`를 10.68.0에서 11.0.0으로 올리고, `sourceMappingURL` 주석 제거 정규식을 고쳐 두었던 pnpm patch를 걷어냈습니다.

- 이 정규식 수정은 우리가 Sentry에 직접 올린 [getsentry/sentry-javascript#24022](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24022)로 반영되어 11.0.0에 들어갔습니다. 설치된 11.0.0 코드에 같은 정규식이 들어 있는 것을 확인했습니다.

- v11에서 바뀐 설정 두 가지를 맞췄습니다. `withSentryConfig` import 경로를 `@sentry/nextjs/config`로 바꿨고, v11에서 빠진 `disableLogger` 옵션을 지웠습니다.

- v11은 `dataCollection`을 비워 두면 쿠키, 요청·응답 본문, IP까지 수집합니다. 지금과 같은 범위를 유지하려고 `sentry-options.ts`에 v10 기본값을 명시했습니다. 쿠키에는 인증 토큰이, TTS/STT 요청 본문에는 발화 원문이 들어 있습니다.

- Node 하한을 `>=20.19.0 <22.0.0 || >=22.12.0`으로 올리고 README·AGENTS.md·`.npmrc` 주석을 맞췄습니다. `@sentry/nextjs` 11이 이 범위를 요구하고, 레포는 `engine-strict=true`라 범위 밖 Node에서는 `pnpm install`이 실패합니다. CI는 `.nvmrc`(22)로 최신 22를 받아 범위 안입니다.

## 리뷰 포인트

- `sentry-options.ts`의 `dataCollection` 값은 업스트림 `MIGRATION.md`의 "keep the v10 default behavior" 예시를 그대로 옮겼습니다.

- 모바일 `@sentry/react-native`는 v10 계열(10.37)을 계속 씁니다. hoisted 설치에서 web은 11, 모바일은 10.37을 각자 중첩 경로로 받도록 설치된 것을 확인했습니다.

- 로컬 확인: 루트 lint·typecheck·test 통과, 프로덕션 빌드 청크 68개 전부 `node --check` 통과(rrweb 청크 포함).

- 로컬에는 Sentry 토큰이 없어 소스맵 업로드·삭제 경로는 배포 빌드에서 확인하려고 합니다. 머지 후 확인할 것은 두 가지입니다. 배포 빌드에서 소스맵이 올라가고 청크가 온전한지, Sentry 이벤트에 쿠키·IP가 담기지 않는지.

## 체크리스트

- [x] 코드 추가 500줄 이하 (5~10분 리뷰 가능한 볼륨)
- [x] 브랜치 이름에 이슈 번호 포함 (`feat/LAN-XX`)

author: geiserx
body:
El sitio solo sabía de Pablo entre 30 y 70 e.c., y la familia quería leer cualquier relato con su mapa. Esta tanda construye v1 (Pedro y todo Hechos, grafo de personas, carriles configurables), v2 (los cuatro evangelios en armonía con la tabla A7, Judá bajo medos y persas, Babilonia a lo largo de los siglos, lugares inciertos como zonas, cortina) y lo que estaba para más adelante (reyes de Judá e Israel con las dos cronologías, recorridos guiados, modo presentación). 109 de las 159 ideas del catálogo quedan dentro; las 50 que no, con su motivo en la hoja de ruta.

**Datos** (cada hecho con fuente, razón, fecha de consulta y estado; 898 fuentes de wol.jw.org leídas y citadas por párrafo)

| Tipo | v0 | Ahora |
|---|---|---|
| Lugares | 58 | 166 (29 con candidatos) |
| Personas | 8 | 222 (376 relaciones fechadas) |
| Sucesos | 7 | 315 (128 en armonía A7, 83 en orden de Hechos) |
| Periodos | 3 | 87 (52 reinados, 11 emperadores, 9 eras, 6 potencias) |
| Cartas | 14 | 22 |
| Viajes | 6 | 8 |
| Hallazgos y recorridos | 0 | 7 y 4 |

**Sitio**: línea de tiempo de 4026 a.e.c. a 100 e.c. con zoom de milenios a días, carriles por persona guardados en la dirección, meses hebreos, trayectoria para cualquier persona con sucesos fechados, grafo, lectura capítulo a capítulo, recorridos con preguntas, portada por épocas, modo presentación, zonas para lugares inciertos, hallazgos, y dos relieves más para que Babilonia y Susa entren en el mapa.

**Vídeos**: índice por lugar (73), persona (86) y pasaje (802 de 1189 capítulos), desde los subtítulos privados, que nunca entran en el repo.

**Comprobado**
- `build`, `validate` y `validate --links` (1053 URL, 0 fallos) en verde. Cuatro comprobaciones nuevas vistas en rojo con su prueba rota: 0 fichas mínimas sin rellenar, coordenadas de OpenBible contra su fichero original, ninguna frase de 8 palabras copiada de la fuente en caché, y nombres de vídeo iguales a los lugares.
- Auditoría adversaria: 80 hechos al azar (10 por carril) abiertos contra su página de wol.jw.org, revisión del código de `site/js/` y de las fuentes (nada de otras confesiones, nivel 2 solo con nivel 1 que lo cite). 34 hallazgos, ninguno de severidad alta; todos corregidos salvo uno informativo.
- 34 pantallas en Chrome sin cabeza (escritorio y 430 px) sin errores de consola; las direcciones de v0 abren lo mismo que antes.

**Pendiente conocido**
- Al seleccionar a Jesús el encuadre abarca hasta Egipto (por la huida) y los rótulos de Judea se apilan a ese zoom.
- La ficha de hallazgos aún no muestra `donde_hoy`; ningún hallazgo lo usa todavía.
- Egipto no tiene fecha de fin ni Asiria de inicio como potencias: ninguna publicación de jw.org las da. Grecia y Medopersia se solapan un año (332 frente a 331). Roma termina en 476 según Perspicacia «Roma».
- Los patriarcas (Adán, Noé, Abrahán, Moisés…) aún no existen como personas; sus sucesos sí.

Este PR supera los 100 ficheros, así que la revisión automática no corre; la revisión es la auditoría descrita arriba más una revisión independiente del diff antes de fusionar.

author: kastnerjon
body:
## Summary
- replace the points-mode terminal `Score / N PTS` block with one centered baseball-native callout
- render current v4 outcomes exactly as `HR! 4 PTS`, `3B 3 PTS`, `2B 2 PTS`, `1B 1 PT`, `BB 0.5 PTS`, and `K 0 PTS`
- consume the canonical resolved outcome and the authoritative awarded-point delta from the existing engine-resolved pre/post terminal states
- keep Classic terminal presentation unchanged

## Scope contract
- **Goal:** make the resolved Daily Nine callout centered and baseball-native without changing game rules.
- **Owning layer:** `apps/web` presentation/composition.
- **In scope:** terminal presentation model, terminal point handoff, focused rendering tests, narrow CSS, and canonical documentation.
- **Out of scope:** scoring rules, persisted results, comparison populations, scorecard columns, player reveal tables, archive identity, or broader AtBatCard redesign.
- **Acceptance checks:** exact-format tests for all six outcomes, points/outcome independence coverage, existing Classic regression coverage, repository CI, exact-head Vercel Preview, and mobile-safe centered layout.
- **Stop conditions:** any required scoring/persistence change, new result contract, or broader component redesign.

## Architecture
- **Owning layer:** web presentation owns the string/layout; engine remains authoritative for scoring transitions.
- **Dependency impact:** no new dependencies or package-boundary changes.
- **Boundary check:** React no longer recomputes terminal points. `DailyInningGame` passes the delta between the already-resolved terminal points state and the pre-terminal points state; `ResultDisplay` only renders that value beside the canonical resolved outcome.
- **Duplication check:** reuses `formatDailyAwardedPoints`; no second scoring map or outcome-from-points mapping.
- **Portability impact:** no portable-domain contracts changed.
- **Scope check:** one presentation concern; no decomposition trigger crossed.
- **Review disposition:** fresh-eye review removed stale scoring inputs from `ResultDisplay`; restored/pending terminal state remains based on existing persisted pre/post states.

## Testing
- pure presentation coverage for HR / 3B / 2B / 1B / BB / K, punctuation, singular/plural points, and outcome/points independence
- ResultDisplay coverage for current points-v4 callouts plus unchanged Classic presentation
- exact-head CI and Vercel Preview required before merge

## Documentation impact
Updates `docs/START-HERE.md`, `tasks/todo.md`, and `tasks/plans/2026-09-27-near-term-product-sequence.md` to record the approved terminal callout and the two remaining Daily UI polish PRs before archive-beta identity work.

author: conanbke-ai
body:
## Purpose
Add the first fixed model stage after WEIGHT-DRYAD-V001.

## Modeling unit
Geometry/weight metadata is fruit-level, so this baseline evaluates **one FRUIT_ID as one regression sample**. The 22 RGB views are not duplicated into 22 geometry samples.

## Fixed models
- TRAIN_MEAN
- LINEAR_WIDTH_HEIGHT
- LINEAR_WIDTH_HEIGHT_AREA

Primary model is predeclared as LINEAR_WIDTH_HEIGHT_AREA. No validation-driven model selection is performed.

## Metrics
Per train / validation / test:
- MAE
- RMSE
- R²
- Bias
- Max absolute error
- 12/16/22g weight-grade accuracy
- grade confusion

## Leakage / test policy
- FRUIT_ID atomic split required
- train-only feature standardization
- test is report-once
- no test tuning or threshold optimization

## Runtime gate
Execution blocks until an actual frozen WEIGHT-DRYAD-V001 exists.

## Command
`python -m ml.weight_baseline.geometry_v001 --snapshot-dir data/snapshots/WEIGHT-DRYAD-V001 --output-dir artifacts/weight/geometry-v001`

## Next
After real baseline execution: threshold residual audit -> RGB-only baseline -> geometry vs RGB comparison -> optional combined model.

author: thegdsks
body:
## Summary

Combines six FRICTION.md items into one batch, all small, independent, well-scoped fixes verified against the original dogfood repro context in FRICTION.md.

- **F-017**: `apps create --file` now accepts `build.type: static`, routed through the same `deploy-spec` plumbing, named after the app itself instead of `<app>-<service>` (no more `site-site`). Flags that only make sense for a container (`--port`, `--build-arg`, `--node-id`, etc.) are now rejected with a clear error on this path instead of being silently ignored.
- **F-022**: the static-site `IMAGE` column no longer leaks a server filesystem path; shows the commit SHA or `static` instead, fixed at the source (`ServiceOutcome.Image`) so both the CLI table and the raw JSON API response are correct.
- **F-018**: Railpack's generic "Node.js" label is refined to "Next.js" when `package.json` depends on `next`. Root cause of the blank `FRAMEWORK` column: CLI-triggered builds never called the `build/detect` pre-flight the web wizard uses, so `detected_framework` was never sent; now both `apps create` and `apps builds trigger` call it best-effort and forward the result.
- **F-021**: `apps create` from a git source now prints a hint to run `apps deploys wait <app>` after triggering, instead of leaving the operator with no pointer to follow progress.
- **F-020**: `apps git-source set` now returns an absolute `webhook_url` when a public primary domain is configured (falls back to relative otherwise). Also fixed a real bug this surfaced: 4 webhook auto-registration call sites were double-prefixing the URL now that it's already absolute.
- **F-023**: `import <repo-url>` now accepts a self-hosted git URL with no owner/repo path segment (matching the dogfood run's own HTTP-served test setup); known forge hosts (github.com, gitlab.com, etc.) still require a real owner/repo since a bare path can never be valid there.

FRICTION.md's status rows for all six are updated from `open` to `fixed`.

## What this does not do

- Does not touch F-019 (Railpack `next start` log noise, runbook-noted only) or F-024 (host port staleness, runbook-noted only), left open as polish items.
- Does not add UI changes: an Explore pass confirmed the app-create UI already fully supports `build.type: static` with no port/container fields, and the deploy-spec results table already consumes the same `image` field the backend fix sanitizes, so no UI change was needed for F-017/F-022.
- Does not touch F-004/F-005 (build-time env, build args), explicitly marked out of scope during the current feature freeze, or F-016 (HTTP to HTTPS redirect), which FRICTION.md flags as needing an ingress design decision rather than a drive-by fix.

## Test plan

- [x] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` clean
- [x] `golangci-lint run` (private cache) clean, 0 issues, across all touched packages
- [x] Affected-package tests pass: `cmd/levelrail-cli`, `internal/deploy`, `internal/api`, `internal/apiclient`, `internal/build`, `internal/importplan`
- [x] New table-driven tests per fix: `TestPlanFromFlags` (static cases), `TestDeploySpec_StaticService_OutcomeImageNeverLeaksPath`, `TestDeploySpec_SingleServiceName`, `TestNextJSLabel`, `TestTriggerCreatePlanBuild_DetectsFramework`, `TestHandleSetGitSource_WebhookURL_AbsoluteWhenPrimaryDomainConfigured`, `TestRepoParts_SelfHostedNoOwner`
- [x] Verified the two branches merged into this one (F-017/F-022 and F-018/F-020/F-021/F-023) coexist correctly where they touch the same file (`apps_create.go`): the static-site path returns before the framework-detection/build-trigger logic runs, confirmed by reading the merged control flow
- [x] Pre-commit and pre-push hooks passed on every commit (gofmt, migration-collision check, gitleaks, vet, lint, em/en-dash sweep, build, web tsc/eslint, conventional-commit format, no Co-Authored-By)

author: onyxgolden
body:
## Summary
Two Designer palette changes Jason asked for:

1. **Shape search.** A "Search shapes" box sits under the pinned tools (Select, Erase, Pan) in the left palette. It searches everything placeable at once: palette tools (including saved custom shapes), the full furniture catalog, and every symbol domain (building elements, site and outdoor, MEP fixtures, process equipment including TEMA, piping).
   - Results replace the categories while you type; clicking one arms it for placement, the same as picking it normally. Escape clears the search.
   - Every word must match, in any order, in the name or the category. Ranking goes exact name, then prefix, then word-start, then substring, then category-only matches.
   - Ranking lives in the pure `designerShapeSearch.js`.
2. **All categories start collapsed.** Every palette category and the "Favorite shapes" section start collapsed each time the Designer opens. Expanding works as normal within a session; the old remembered expand/collapse layout is no longer read, since remembering it would contradict "start collapsed". Favorites themselves are still remembered.

author: alshstf
body:
Решения по двум вопросам аудита, которые владелец поручил принять мне (2026-09-28).

## Жанры-алиасы (#286)
`internal/genres/aliases.json` — 65 кодов сводятся к кодам нашего словаря:
- **алиасы из `genres.json` клиента FLibrary** (тот же жанр под другим кодом) — 36 кодов: `adv_all`→`adventure`, `sf_all`→`sf_etc`, `painting`→`visual_arts`, `popadancy`→`popadanec`, `psy_generic`→`sci_psychology`…;
- **«…: прочее»**, у которых наш общий код уже так называется: `humor_all`→`humor` («Юмор: прочее»), `det_all`/`det_other`→`detective`, `religion_all`, `poetry_all`, `antique_all`, `sci_all`;
- **коды-слова и дефисные коды litnet** — туда, где соответствие очевидно: «Биографии и мемуары»→`nonf_biography`, «Шпионский Детектив»→`det_espionage`, `litrpg`→`sf_litrpg`, `urban-fantasy`→`sf_fantasy_city`, `popadantsy-*`/`back-to-ussr`→`popadanec`, `love_fantasy`→`love_sf`…

Неочевидные (`wuxia`, `action`, `rusreal`, `magician_book`, `cinema_theatre` — 9 книг) не свожу.

- **Импорт** сводит коды при записи (`genres.CanonicalCodes` в `processRecord`, тот же набор уходит в документ поиска).
- **Существующие данные** — разовый `genres.MergeAliases` (гейт `genre_aliases_merged_v1`): книги, избранные жанры, скрытые жанры (общие и пользовательские настройки `content`), ручные правки жанров; строка алиаса удаляется; works-индекс досинкается.
- **На проде:** 44 строки-алиаса, 1 088 привязок книг. Избранное, скрытые жанры и правки на алиасы не ссылаются, но код их переносит.

## Порог доминирования в межавторской серии (#298): ½ → **0,8**
Между 50 и 80 % у одного автора на проде 631 название.
- **Почти все — издательские серии с автором-«локомотивом»:** «Мировая классика» (Нагибин 58 из 78), «Спецназ ВДВ», «Русская жизнь», «Исторический роман (АСТ)», «Библиотека пионера». При ½ каждая дробится на однокнижные «циклы» в карточках всех прочих авторов.
- **Авторских циклов с продолжателями там единицы:** «Изумрудный город» (Волков 70 %), «Швейк», «Винни-Пух», «Ведун». Цена ошибки для них мягче: серия остаётся целой, только в карточке автора уходит в блок межавторских.

Разделить их никаким порогом нельзя, поэтому 0,8. «Ниро Вульф» (99 %) и «Колесо времени» (94 %) остаются циклами.

## Как применится на проде
Правила серий (и служебные авторы из #319) применяет только импорт INPX. Разовый шаг `reimport_series_rules_v1` сбрасывает хэш коллекций, и стартовый импорт проходит полностью: ~1 ч на 470 тыс. книг, сайт работает. Он же перепишет жанры книг уже сведёнными кодами и обновит индекс книг (OPDS).

## Проверки
- **Тесты:**
  - `TestMergeAliases_Integration` — книга, избранное, скрытые жанры с дублем, ручная правка, удаление строки, идемпотентность;
  - все 65 алиасов ведут в словарь и сами не коды словаря;
  - `TestImport_MultiAuthorSeries` — «Мировая классика» 60 % → общая серия, «Ниро Вульф» 80 % → цикл.
- Локально `go test ./...` и `golangci-lint` зелёные.
- CLAUDE.md обновлён. README не меняется.

body:
## Summary

Part of #63 (E), closes #67.

Dropping a card or run on a foundation or tableau pile where the move is illegal used to silently do nothing. Now that pile gets a **red outline for half a second** (30 ticks at 60 TPS), or until the next click, whichever comes first. It is static, with no animation, as the issue asks.

- `Mediator`: `handlePointerUp` now checks the `bool` each `Board.Move...` returns, and on failure records a `RejectedDrop{Target, Index}` (a foundation slot by suit, or a tableau index). `Tick()` counts it down, `RejectedDrop()` reports it, and a new pointer-down clears it.
- What counts as rejected: an illegal drop on a foundation or tableau pile, including a multi-card run on the foundation. Dropping on empty space, or back on the card's own tableau pile, is still just a cancel with no red outline.
- `PileComponent`: highlights become `Highlight{Rect, Color}` (was `[]image.Rectangle`), so it can draw yellow drop targets (#66) and red rejections through the same path while still deciding nothing. The colors now live in the scene (`validDropColor`, `rejectedDropColor`).
- `SolitaireScene`: `Update` calls `mediator.Tick()`, and `syncHighlights` adds the red outline in the same place the yellow one would go (the top card, the empty slot, or the suit's foundation slot).
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: describes `RejectedDrop`/`Tick`/`Highlight`, and points the remaining "where this might grow" item at #61.

Coverage: `internal/game/scenes/solitaire` 93.5% → 94.0%.

author: loggzix
body:
## What changed

### perf: the object id cache compacts a few times, not once per new id

Past 1024 live objects every new id walked the whole cache, so listing a
20k-object scene was quadratic. The threshold now doubles past what
survives a compaction, and an id already cached reuses its entry.

### fix: scene complexity counts a non-readable mesh's triangles

GetTriangleCount read mesh.triangles twice, copying the index array
each time, and a mesh without CPU data threw into a catch that counted
it as 0. Sum the triangle submeshes' index counts instead, as
get_mesh_info does.

### perf: find_references yields by time and wakes the editor first

The manual reverse scan yielded every 64 assets, a few ms of work, and
an unfocused editor resumes a Task.Yield only on its next tick, up to
100 ms away. Yield every 50 ms instead and queue a player-loop update
before it. 4,037 assets in an unfocused editor: 3.9-7.0 s -> 0.7-1.1 s.

### perf: lookups rank before they pay for a path, a type walk or an assembly name

SuggestTargets built every candidate's root path before scoring its
name; get_top_memory_objects walked every assembly's GetTypes() per call
for a type outside the known list; reflect_api search built an
AssemblyName for every indexed type before ranking it. Path only for
a hit, TypeCache for the type, rank before the scope check.

### fix: get_component_properties filters while it reads, not after the window

name_filter ran over the first max_properties properties read, so with
descend on a long array every match past the window was missing. The
filter now decides what fills the window, and the page and cursor count
matches only.

### fix: an answered call stops its stall probe

Every marshalled call started a 20 s Task.Delay that nothing cancelled,
so its closure kept the call's result, a screenshot included, reachable
for 20 s after the client had it. Cancel the delay when the call
completes.

### perf: fetch_docs requests a call's pages together

The pages of one call are independent and were fetched one after
another. Five pages: 2.5-3.5 s -> 0.5-0.6 s.

### fix: asset tools save the asset they changed, not the whole project

SaveAssets() wrote every dirty asset in memory as a side effect of an
atlas, ScriptableObject, animation, terrain or volume edit. Save the
edited asset with SaveAssetIfDirty; a sub-asset add or remove marks its
profile dirty first so the file is still written.

## Verification

- EditMode suite, Unity 6000.3.10f1 batchmode, this branch alone on `main`: 1074 tests, 0 failed, 23 skipped (the GPU/URP-only ones).
- New or changed tests:
  - `GetComponentProperties_FilterFindsAPropertyPastTheFirstWindow`: Passed
  - `IdsForThousandsOfLiveObjectsCompactTheCacheAFewTimesNotOncePerId`: Passed
  - `AMeshWithoutCpuDataStillCountsItsTriangleSubmeshes`: Passed
- Not verified in a live editor: find_references and fetch_docs timings in the commit messages were measured in a live unfocused editor

## Checklist

- [x] I tested the package in a clean Unity project (6000.3.10f1 batchmode; not run on 2022.3)
- [ ] I verified `Window > KitWright > MCP Window` opens and the server starts correctly (not re-run for this branch)

author: amineelba
body:
## What

`scripts/seed-homepage-deploy-once.ts` uses top-level `await` but declares no import or export, so TypeScript does not treat it as a module:

```
TS1375: 'await' expressions are only allowed at the top level of a file
when that file is a module... Consider adding an empty 'export {}'.
```

CI stops at the **Typecheck** step, so migrations, unit, integration, contract, build and E2E have all been **skipped on `main` since `efb7465`** — the branch has had no test coverage. `next build` runs TypeScript too, so the same error fails a production deploy once the build reaches that stage.

`export {}` is the fix TypeScript itself proposes, and the smallest one.

Also regenerates `src/payload-types.ts`. `e0fd21e` added the `updateGlobalContent` MCP tool without running `generate:types`, so the committed types do not describe the committed config.

## What this does NOT fix

The 2026-09-28 production deploy failure has a **different cause**. That build died earlier, in the seed step, before `next build` ever ran:

```
locales to write: fr, en, es
  wrote fr
The English (EN) translation is "needs_review", not approved. Every locale
edited since the last publish (EN) must be approved under Translation status
before this document can be published.
 ELIFECYCLE  Command failed with exit code 1.
```

`seed-homepage.ts` writes each locale with `draft: false` and never writes the editorial state, so the publish guard correctly refuses EN. Fixing that means either approving EN/ES for publication or letting a content seed fail without stopping the build — both are owner decisions rather than build hygiene, and are deliberately left alone here.

Consequence: after this merges, CI goes green and a deploy can reach `next build`, but the homepage seed will still exit 1 on production until that decision is made.

## Verification

Run on a database built with CI's seed sequence:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm run lint` | 0 errors (8 pre-existing warnings) |
| `pnpm run typecheck` | clean |
| `pnpm run test:unit` | 93 passed |
| `pnpm run test:int` | 36 passed |
| `pnpm run test:contract` | 15 passed |
| `pnpm run build` | clean, route table unchanged |

No content, migration, schema, snapshot or environment change.

body:
## What this does

A save's `doors` and `windows` now carry only the ids whose state differs from a new game's. It compares against a baseline built once, on the first save, from `buildDoors(null)` / `buildWindows(null)`. Load is unchanged. A new game's save drops from 243,210 characters to 2,179.

## Issues

Closes #302

## Handoff

`handoffs/save-only-changed-openings.md`, moved to `handoffs/archive/` in this PR.

Design decision 1: **(a)**. The baseline is computed lazily on the first save and cached for the session (`openingBaseline()`), which is safe because the definitions never read `state`. Design decision 2: `openingBaseline()` returns `{ doors, windows }`, and `doorSaveFields()` picks off the saved triple. Both are recorded in the changelog.

## Version

- [x] `ashfall.html` changed: `GAME_CONFIG.VERSION` bumped (PATCH, 0.10.0 → 0.10.1) and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry added at the top

## Deferred

Nothing deferred. The handoff named two follow-ups conditionally, and neither was filed. `savedRoomState()`'s per-save cost doesn't need a pass yet: a whole save takes about 55 ms. Power-state trimming waits until the wiring passes grow it.

## Validation

Headless Chromium, run against this build and `origin/main` (v0.10.0):
- New game save: 2,179 chars, with `doors` and `windows` both empty (v0.10.0: 243,210).
- Round trip covering a hand-unlocked front door, a door opened, a bolt drawn, a door forced, one window opened and one broken. Exactly those 4 doors and 2 windows were saved. After reload, every door and window state matched the state before saving.
- A v0.10.0 save loads in this build with the same states, and this build's save loads in v0.10.0 with the same states.

body:
XL-2 fold cleanup, owner quiet-seal-543 (the split with bright-boar-848 was ruled 2026-09-28). This retires two `gunbc.recurring_failure_mode` rows; the trigger capability of each is delivered here:
- `data_initializer_match_reads_its_scrutinee_from_an_arm_at_v2_body_lowering`
- `match_arm_statement_body_lowers_to_its_first_expression_at_v2_body_lowering`

Both are the same class, a positional fact obtained by searching for its shape, at two sites in `v2.compiler.body_lowering_fold`.

## What

**1. Scrutinee.** `data d: Bool = match h(a) { X => true .. }` lowered to a match on `true`: `h` and `a` were gone, and the module was accepted.
- **Cause:** `body_lower_match_scrutinee_optional` took the first `binary_expr` found anywhere in the match subtree. A data initializer is folded bottom-up before its declaration is dispatched, so its scrutinee shell is already reduced, and the search found the next `binary_expr`, inside the first arm.
- **Repair:** read the scrutinee from its grammar position. `match_expr` is `seq(match, seq(binary_expr, seq({, ..)))`.
  - `body_lower_match_scrutinee_value` already reads both an unfolded shell and a lowered node.
  - A spine not headed by `match` answers Absent, and the caller refuses it as `match_arm_navigation_refused`.
  - The spine-walk fallback (`_from_spine`, `_on_token`) had no other caller and is deleted.

**2. Arm statement body.** `X =>` then `let t = v` then `e` lowered to `v`: the binder and the continuation were gone.
- **Cause:** `body_lower_match_arm_body_capture_optional` took the first `expr`, then `primary_expr`, then `postfix_expr` found in the arm.
- **Repair, positional read:** the body is now the right of the `=>`.
- **Repair, statement authority:** `body_lower_match_arm_body_lowered` (both arm routes) lowers a statement body through `body_lower_stmt_spine`, the authority fn bodies and if arms already use.
- **Measured on a parsed arm:** the parser realizes `match_arm_stmt_body` **unwrapped**. `parse_match_arm_stmt_body` returns the bare `stmt` repeat with no production shell. So a statement body is recognized structurally, as a spine headed by a `stmt` production that has a successor.

## Evidence

Local `claim_batch`, one binary built from this branch. Main is a `git worktree` of `origin/main` 8ebd8b671d with this PR's two claim files copied in.

| claim | main fold | head |
|---|---|---|
| `a_statement_after_a_let_in_a_match_arm_is_conserved_holds` | FAIL | PASS |
| `a_data_initializer_match_scrutinee_is_conserved_holds` | FAIL | PASS |
| `the_same_match_as_a_fn_body_conserves_its_scrutinee_holds` (**paired control**) | PASS | PASS |
| `a_data_initializer_match_lowers_its_scrutinee_from_the_match_position_holds` | FAIL | PASS |
| `the_same_match_as_a_fn_body_lowers_its_scrutinee_from_the_match_position_holds` (**paired control**) | PASS | PASS |
| `a_match_arm_statement_body_lowers_to_the_let_binding_its_continuation_holds` | FAIL | PASS |
| the six neighbouring pins in `reference_conservation_accepted_drops` | PASS | PASS (unchanged) |

- **Conservation controls:** each asserts that the module is **accepted** and that the named atoms are not dropped, so a refusal cannot green it.
- **Structural controls** (`v2.test.claim.body_lowering.match_position_structure`) read the lowered tree the production route hands the resolver (`module_roots_from_source_root_ingest`). They cover what conservation cannot see:
  - the scrutinee must be the Match's first positional child, as the authored call;
  - the arm body must be a Bind of key, value and continuation **in that order**.
- **The data vs fn-body pair** is the control the side chat required, at both grains. It uses distinct callee names per route, so neither module can satisfy the other's claim.
- **Floor enrolment:** `mps_normalized` and `fn_body_match_scrutinee_subject` are enrolled warm in `v2.workflow.floor_pure_producer_share`. The rows are anchored away from #12436's append point.

**Census:** posted as PR comment 5864468628. All 316 paths paired; 31 atoms recovered (30 through the arm statement body, 1 a fn-body pipe scrutinee); 0 newly absent; 0 refusal changes.

## Coordination

- **#12436 (bright-boar-848):** disjoint fold functions. Both PRs edit `reference_conservation_accepted_drops_test.dag` (different claims) and the same import line. That is a one-line merge; I will integrate with a merge commit once either lands.
- **Stage0:** no generated file derives from the changed functions.

## Carrier wording (for `compiler_frontend_program_status`, not edited here)

> v2 body lowering reads a match's scrutinee and each arm's body from their grammar positions on every route, data initializers included, and lowers an arm's statement body through the statement authority.

author: dmtrkovalenko
body:
There was no way to publish a stable version: the only publish job derives a nightly from the latest tag, and after a `v1.0.0` tag it would have produced `v1.0.0.rc-NN`, which `cargo set-version` rejects.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  D["./scripts/release.sh 1.0.0"] -->|set-version + pnpm version, commit, tag v1.0.0, push| T[tag v1.0.0]
  T --> J[publish job]
  M[push to main] --> J
  J -->|scripts/release-version.sh| V{version}
  V -->|tag| S["1.0.0 → crates.io, npm latest, GitHub release"]
  V -->|main after v1.0.0| N["1.0.1-rc.NN → crates.io, npm nightly"]
  V -->|main after v1.0.0-beta.7| O["1.0.0-beta.7.rc-NN (unchanged scheme)"]
```

- `scripts/release.sh <version>` — developer side, same interface as the one in `fff`: `git pull`, clean-tree and tag checks, `cargo set-version`, `pnpm version` in `fframes-editor`, commit `chore: release <version>`, annotated tag, push.
- `scripts/release-version.sh` — the version CI publishes: the pushed `v*` tag, else a nightly from the nearest tag (`1.0.0-beta.7` → `1.0.0-beta.7.rc-46`, `1.0.0` → `1.0.1-rc.12`).
- `scripts/publish.sh` — the old root `release.sh`; skips `cargo set-version` / `pnpm version` when the tree already carries the version (a release commit does), and picks the npm dist-tag from the version: `rc` → `nightly`, other prerelease → `next`, stable → `latest`.
- Workflow: `on.push.tags: [v*]`; the publish job runs for `main` and `v*` tags, `contents: write` for `gh release create --generate-notes` on tags.

Cutting 1.0.0 is then:

```sh
./scripts/release.sh 1.0.0
```

npm still answers `403 OIDC permission denied` until the trusted publisher for `@fframes/editor` is registered on npmjs.com (repository `dmtrKovalenko/fframes`, workflow `main.yml`); crates.io publishing already works (`1.0.0-beta.7.rc-46` is up).

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Publishing now runs for pushes to `main` and version tags. Pushes to `main` publish nightly versions of the Rust crates and editor; version-tag pushes publish the tagged version and create a GitHub release.
  * A versioned release workflow updates package versions, creates and pushes a release tag, and triggers CI to publish the packages.
* **Documentation**
  * Release instructions now describe nightly publishing from `main` and the versioned release workflow.

- **seed 게이트**: advisory 축이 공집합인 프로필(seed)은 「참고 0건 … 끝에서 한 목록으로」 줄을 내지 않는다(gate JSON 의 `advice` 키는 그대로). 프로필을 못 읽으면(YAML 파손 포함) 줄을 보이는 쪽으로 폴백한다.

body:
## 왜

#1 에서 `verify-brief.py` 를 뗐다. 두 가지 까닭이었다.

- 모델이 쓴 마크다운의 **모양**을 정규식으로 봐서, Codex 13~26차 지적 21건이 여기서 나왔고 고친 자리가 다음 지적을 낳았다.
- **운영에서 돌지 않았다.** CI 의 손으로 만든 픽스처 하나만 봤다.

뗄 때 「저장소의 `git diff` 를 다시 돌려 브리핑과 대조하는 방식으로 main 에서 다시 세운다」고 적었다. 이 PR 이 그 후속이다. 저자가 정한 것은 둘이다.

1. **플러그인에 싣고 커맨드가 돌린다.**
2. **파일 집합과 파일별 +/- 줄 수로 대조한다.**

## 검사기: `vibe-audit/scripts/verify-brief.py`

브리핑에서는 **무엇을 담았다고 하는지**만 읽고, 담았어야 할 것은 git 에 다시 묻는다.

| 보는 것 | git 쪽 |
|---|---|
| 머리 줄(「대상」 · 「기준」 · 「자름」)은 첫 절 앞에서 한 줄씩만, 네 절은 한 번씩만(파일 끝의 빈 절도 절) | — |
| 「대상」 = 지금 HEAD (SHA-1 · SHA-256) | `rev-parse HEAD` |
| 적힌 머지 베이스 = 기준과 HEAD 의 머지 베이스 | `merge-base` |
| 바뀐 파일이 전부 diff 절이나 「담지 않은 것」에 있다 | 커밋된 몫 · 인덱스 몫(`--cached`) · 인덱스→작업트리 몫 `diff --numstat`, 추적 안 된 파일 `ls-files --others` (모두 `:/` 와 같은 제외로) |
| 파일마다 +/- 줄 수 · 바이너리 블록 수 · 블록 수가 같다. 모자라면 「자름: 있음」이고 「담지 않은 것」에 그 경로. 많으면 늘 불일치 | 위 numstat 과 `diff --raw`. 추적 안 된 파일은 커맨드와 같은 `diff --no-index --numstat` |
| 풀지 않은 머지의 경로마다 `diff --cc` 블록 수 · `* Unmerged path` 줄 수가 git 과 같다 | `ls-files -u` 와 커맨드와 같은 두 diff |
| git 에 없는 파일의 diff 가 없다 | 위 집합 |

- **줄 수:** 헝크 머리(`@@ -a,b +c,d @@`)가 적은 만큼만 센다. 헝크 뒤에 붙은 글이나 헝크 안의 `--- a/` 모양 줄에 흔들리지 않는다. 브리핑은 바이트로 읽어 헝크 안의 맨 `\r` 을 줄로 바꾸지 않고, CRLF 로 저장한 브리핑은 `\r\n` 만 `\n` 으로 바꿔 받는다.
- **인덱스 몫:** 스테이지한 변경을 작업트리에서 되돌려도 `--cached` 몫으로 남아 가려지지 않는다.
- **풀지 않은 머지:** 인덱스 · 작업트리 몫은 줄 수를 세지 않고, git 이 내는 표시(내용 충돌은 `diff --cc` 블록, 수정/삭제 충돌은 `* Unmerged path` 줄뿐)를 경로 · 종류별로 대조한다. 그 줄의 경로는 날것이라 줄바꿈 · 맨 `\r` 이 들 수 있다. 그래서 절 · 블록을 가르고 CRLF 를 풀기 **전에** `ls-files -u -z` 의 경로와 긴 것부터 통째로 맞춰 한 줄로 묶는다. 커밋된 몫은 그대로 센다. 「담지 않은 것」은 모자란 표시만 풀어 주고, 충돌 경로도 이름으로 받는다(기준이 HEAD 라 커밋된 몫이 없어도). 표시를 일부만 담았거나 커밋된 몫만 담았으면 보통 블록처럼 「자름: 있음」도 요구한다.
- **블록 수:** 이름만 바꾼 블록처럼 줄이 없는 블록도, 같은 경로의 딴 몫이 줄 수를 채울 때 빠지면 드러난다. 종류가 바뀐 파일(`T`)은 패치 블록 둘로 센다.
- **추적 안 된 파일:** 파이썬으로 세지 않고 git 에게 센다 — 심볼릭 링크(대상 한 줄) · `-diff` 속성(바이너리)을 git 과 다르게 셀 틈이 없다. 파일 · 링크가 아닌 것(안에 든 저장소)과 못 읽는 파일은 「있는지만」 본다(「담지 않은 것」에 적어야 한다).
- **경로:** `rename to` · `copy to` · `+++` · `---` · 머리 줄에서 잡는다. git 이 따옴표로 적은 경로는 C 식으로 풀고, 경로와 저장소 폴더 이름(끝 빈칸 포함)을 모두 바이트 그대로 가른다(`surrogateescape`).
- **diff 모양:** 커맨드가 모든 `git diff` 에 `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv --submodule=short --ignore-submodules=none --no-color` 를 붙이고, 검사기도 같은 플래그로 센다. 접두 설정(`diff.mnemonicPrefix` · `diff.noprefix`)과 색 코드는 검사기가 견딘다.
- **「담지 않은 것」:** 마크다운 코드 스팬을 통째로 가른다. 스팬의 내용이 경로와 같아야 이름으로 친다. 줄바꿈 든 이름은 git 의 따옴표 모양(`"a\nb"`)으로 적는다. 한 스팬이 그대로도 풀어서도 바뀐 경로에 맞으면(`"q"` 가 `"q"` 와 `q`) 어느 쪽도 치지 않는다.
- **키 가림:** 앞 네 글자만 남기고 가려도 줄 수는 그대로라 대조가 견딘다.
- **대장 제외:** 레포가 diff 에서 뺀 대장은 커맨드가 `':(top,literal,exclude)<경로>'` 로 빼고, 검사기에는 `--exclude` 로 넘겨 같은 literal 모양으로 뺀다. 대장 이름이 `*` 여도 같다. 값이 없거나 비면 쓰는 법 오류(종료 2)다.
- **보지 않는 것:** 줄의 내용(가림과 부딪힌다), 커밋 몫과 작업트리 몫을 제 소절에 나눴는지(파일마다 합쳐 센다), 「변경 파일」 · 「커밋」 절, 풀지 않은 머지 블록의 줄 수.

## 운영에서 돌게

- **`/audit-brief`:** 다 쓰면 검사기를 돌리고, **PASS 전에는 감사자를 부르지 않는다.** 머리에 `검사:` 줄을 더했고, 작업트리 몫을 `git diff --cached` 와 `git diff` 로 따로 뽑기, diff 모양 고정 플래그, 대장의 literal 제외, 추적 안 된 파일 루프에서 파일 · 링크가 아닌 것 건너뛰기, 「담지 않은 것」에 경로를 백틱으로 적는 틀을 넣었다. 커맨드는 3,890 → 4,456 문자다(천장 4,500).
- **`sync-agents.sh`:** 검사기를 사본의 `.claude/scripts/` 에 심는다. 기존 방어가 검사기에도 그대로 걸린다.
  - 커밋 안 된 원본
  - HEAD 에 없는 파일
  - 일부만 있는 사본
  - `--force` 로 원본에서 물러난 것 지우기
  - 새로: 심을 폴더 자리에 폴더가 아닌 것이나 링크가, 파일 자리에 끊긴 링크나 폴더가 있으면 `--force` 여도 **쓰기 전에** 멈춘다. `--force` 로 덮을 때 파일 자리의 링크는 지우고 새 파일로 써 사본 밖에 쓰지 않는다
- **`verify-copies.py`:** 그 커밋의 검사기가 사본에 없으면 실패한다.
- **플러그인 설치본의 한계:** 커맨드 본문에서 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` 가 풀리지 않는다(anthropics/claude-code#9354). 훅 · MCP 설정에서만 풀린다. 그래서 커맨드는 「플러그인 폴더의 `scripts/verify-brief.py`」로 찾게 하고, 못 찾으면 `검사:` 에 「못 돌림」과 까닭을 적게 했다. 말없이 건너뛰지 않는다. 사본은 레포 안 경로라 이 문제가 없다.

## 무는지

- **`scripts/test-verify-brief.py`**(`gates.sh` 의 일곱째 게이트): 외부 diff · 줄 수를 바꾸는 textconv · 복사 찾기 · 서브모듈 무시를 켠 임시 저장소(폴더 이름 `repo\xff `)에 커밋된 변경, 풀지 않은 머지(내용 충돌 · 수정/삭제 충돌, 이름이 `"gone.txt"` 인 것, 줄바꿈 든 이름 셋 — 둘째 줄이 `diff --git` 모양인 것 포함 — 과 맨 `\r` 로 끝나는 이름), 스테이지하고 작업트리만 되돌린 파일, 작업트리, 추적 안 된 파일(빈칸 · 한글 · 탭 · 줄바꿈 이름, `q` 와 `"q"`, 심볼릭 링크 · 끊긴 링크, `-diff` 속성, UTF-8 이 아닌 이름 둘, 안에 든 저장소, root 가 아니면 못 읽는 파일), 헝크 안에 맨 `\r` 이 든 파일, 바이너리와 텍스트 사이를 오간 파일, 이름 바꿈 뒤 고친 파일, 복사, 파일→링크, 서브모듈(gitlink), `a/` 로 시작하는 폴더, 이름이 `*` 인 대장을 둔다. 여기에 커맨드와 **같은 git 명령**으로 브리핑을 만든다. SHA-256 저장소에서 한 번 더 만든다.
  - **통과해야 하는 14가지:** 그대로, 하위 폴더에서 실행, 키 가림, 「담지 않은 것」에 적고 뺌, 줄바꿈 든 이름을 따옴표 모양으로 적고 뺌, 자름 선언, `diff.mnemonicPrefix` · `core.quotePath=false` · `diff.noprefix` · `color.ui=always` 로 만든 브리핑, SHA-256 저장소, CRLF 로 저장한 브리핑, 기준을 HEAD 로 두고 충돌 블록을 잘라 「담지 않은 것」에 적은 것, 기준을 HEAD 로 두고 수정/삭제 충돌의 표시를 통째로 빼 「담지 않은 것」에 적은 것
  - **떨어져야 하는 34가지:** 추적 안 된 파일 누락, 작업트리 누락, `git diff HEAD` 하나로 뽑아 스테이지 몫이 가려짐, 풀지 않은 머지의 `diff --cc` 블록 누락 · `* Unmerged path` 줄 누락 · 날것 경로 바꿔치기 · 줄바꿈 든 이름의 표시를 앞머리 이름으로 바꿈 · 표시를 더 넣고 「담지 않은 것」으로 덮음 · 표시 하나만 빼고 자름 없이 「담지 않은 것」에만 적음 · 커밋된 몫만 담고 표시를 빼 자름 없이 「담지 않은 것」에만 적음, 말없는 자름, 파일 이름 없는 자름, 본문에만 적은 「자름」, 두 줄인 「자름」, 블록을 두 번 넣고 자름으로 덮음, `@backup` · 빈칸 · 이중 백틱 스팬으로 이어지는 딴 경로를 적은 자름, 두 경로에 맞는 `"q"` 스팬, UTF-8 이 아닌 이름 하나 누락, 바이너리→텍스트 · 텍스트→바이너리 파일의 작업트리 몫 누락, 이름 바꿈 블록 누락, 서브모듈 변경 누락, 건너뛴 안의 저장소를 안 적음, 두 번 나온 `## diff`, 파일 끝의 빈 `## diff`, `--exclude '*'` 로 비운 diff, 고정 플래그 없이 뽑은 브리핑, 지난 HEAD, 틀린 머지 베이스, 섞인 diff, 절 없음, 대장 제외 누락
  - **쓰는 법 오류여야 하는 3가지:** `--exclude` 뒤 값 없음 · 빈 값 · `/`
  - 떨어짐은 종료 1 **과** `FAIL` 출력을 함께 요구한다 — 파이썬 예외도 종료 1 이라, 죽은 것을 떨어진 것으로 셀 수 있었다.
  - Codex 리뷰로 고친 곳은 옛 검사기에 돌리거나 고친 곳을 하나씩 되돌려, 그에 맞는 케이스가 틀리는 것을 확인했다(못 읽는 파일은 `nobody` 로).
- **`eval.yml` 「게이트가 무는가」:** 러너 부분은 그대로 두었다.
  - 사본 심기가 검사기를 심는지 본다.
  - 심을 폴더 자리에 파일이 있는 사본, 폴더 자리가 바깥 폴더를 가리키는 링크인 사본, 파일 자리에 끊긴 링크가 있는 사본, `--force` 로 파일 자리에 폴더가 있는 사본에서 아무것도 쓰지 않고 멈추는지 본다(옛 스크립트로는 이 스텝들이 떨어진다).
  - 사본을 손으로 심는 시험에서 검사기도 꺼내 심는다.
  - 사본을 심은 커밋을 **검사기를 가진 것으로** 골라, 검사기 빠진 사본이 떨어지는지 늘 본다(없으면 에러). 로컬에서 이 스텝을 뽑아 `scripts_missing()` 을 꺼 두면 떨어지는 것을 확인했다.
- **로컬:**
  - 임시 복제본에서 확인했다: 사본 심기가 검사기를 심는다, 검사기만 빠진 사본은 거절하고 `--force` 로 채운다, 원본에서 물러난 검사기를 `--force` 가 지운다, 검사기가 빠진 사본을 `verify-copies.py` 가 떨어뜨린다.
  - ERP 실제 저장소에서 11,305줄 diff 로 만든 브리핑이 PASS 했다(첫 커밋 기준).
- **`gates.sh`:** 일곱 다 통과.

## 문서

- `vibe-audit/evals/README.md` 에 「브리핑 검사기를 git 과 대조하는 방식으로 다시 세웠다」 절을 더하고(지금 모양과 숫자로), 브리핑 표의 줄을 고쳤다.
- `AGENTS.md` 의 「검사기는 이 브랜치에 없다」 줄이 이제 사실과 달라 고쳤다. 새 검사기는 평소대로 봐 달라고 적었고, 「보지 않는 것」은 알려진 한계로 적었다. **리뷰 지침 파일이라 저자가 확인해 주세요.**

## 안 한 것

author: xtreemze
body:
## Summary

Fix repeated `zoomToContent()` calls so they progressively move deeper instead of resetting to the same fitted camera first.

- compute the current readable content fit without mutating camera state
- center on that content context
- advance from `max(currentZoom, fittedZoom)` by the semantic +0.85 step
- preserve the existing application zoom ceiling
- return without moving the camera when there is no placed content

## Why

The previous implementation did:

1. `fitToContent()`
2. `zoom += 0.85`

on every invocation.

That makes repeated “Zoom to related nodes” actions plateau at the same fitted+0.85 camera. Manual wheel/pinch can continue deeper, but the explicit content-zoom command cannot.

The intended distinction is:

- **Fit**: idempotently frame the content extent.
- **Zoom**: progressively advance inspection depth around that content.

## Tests

A deterministic regression now calls `zoomToContent()` twice and verifies both calls increase zoom by the semantic 0.85 step.

## Dependency

Stacked on #893 because both touch the same startup/content camera policy area. After #893 merges, this PR can be retargeted to `main` without carrying unrelated changes.

body:
## Why

After #64 shipped, the phone feed couldn't be checked from `grafana.hirata.dev`: **Explore wasn't available.**

- `[auth.jwt]` has `auto_sign_up = true` and no role mapping, so every Cloudflare Access user is created as **Viewer**. Viewers can't open Explore.
- Confirmed on laf3 by reading a copy of `grafana.db`: `admin` is Admin; the only Access user is `Viewer`.
- `disable_login_form = true` makes the local `admin` account unreachable from the public hostname, so nobody could promote anyone from the web.

## What changes

- `grafana.ini.j2`: when `GRAFANA_ADMIN_EMAILS` is set, add
  `role_attribute_path = contains(`[…emails…]`, email) && 'Admin' || 'Viewer'`.
  The role is recomputed from the Cloudflare-verified email on **every** login, so it can't drift, and roles changed in the UI are overwritten at the next login.
- `GRAFANA_ADMIN_EMAILS` comes from `.env` (comma-separated), like `CLOUDFLARE_TEAM_NAME`. **Emails stay out of this public repo.** When it's unset, the output is identical to today.
- CI: `grafana.ini` is now also rendered with JWT **on** (via `template_vars`, because mock-vars arrive as extra vars and outrank task vars). The existing JWT-off render is unchanged.
- Docs: `.env.example` and a `docs/lgtm.md` section on roles for Access users.

## Test plan

- [x] JMESPath checked against sample claims: listed email → `Admin`, other email → `Viewer`, no email claim → `Viewer`
- [x] CI render: JWT-off `grafana.ini` has no `role_attribute_path`; JWT-on render has it with both mock emails
- [x] `yamllint .` clean
- [ ] Add `GRAFANA_ADMIN_EMAILS=<email>` to `~/code/homelab/.env`

- [ ] Reload `grafana.hirata.dev`: the user becomes Admin and **Explore** appears
- [ ] Explore → Loki → `{push_client="visible"}` shows the phone feed
